canonical_operation.verification: tenant-qualified persistence, focused security tests, atomic audit, idempotent retry, and authoritative post-commit reread

source_behavior.job_ownership: unknown and other-owner IDs have identical not-found semantics
source_behavior.execution: save persists schedule only; queue/run is a separate operation

laravel_adaptation.account_mapping: source account-owned sites map to active tenant-owned Site rows; persisted jobs additionally bind owner_user_id to the authenticated user

runtime_path: web middleware supplies session and CSRF validation; auth and tenant.context execute before controller
TenantAuthorizer requires operations.manage from the active tenant membership
controller accepts only an explicit allowlist of schedule fields and rejects caller tenant, owner, site_name, provider, secret, token, action and payload fields as unsupported
site lookup is tenant-qualified and foreign or missing site IDs return the same 404 class
create derives tenant_id, owner_user_id and site_name server-side, checks seo.audit.enabled when applicable and automation.rules.max before first persistence
POST requires Idempotency-Key; identical replay returns the same persisted row without duplicate audit while key reuse with changed state returns 409
update lookup is tenant plus authenticated owner qualified; foreign-owner, foreign-tenant and missing direct IDs fail closed
PUT uses expected_version; exact lost-response replay is a no-op, conflicting stale writes return 409, and real changes advance version exactly once
DB transaction atomically persists the schedule and redacted configuration audit; no queue, scheduler, connector, AI provider or billing provider call is performed
after commit the service rereads by tenant plus owner plus id and verifies the requested safe configuration before returning success

authorization_and_isolation.csrf: web middleware; only billing webhook is globally exempt and this route is not exempt

validation_and_integrity.name: required non-whitespace string max 200
validation_and_integrity.type: Synchronization or SEO Audit only; Content Operation remains unavailable
validation_and_integrity.response: safe schedule fields only; tenant, owner, idempotency hash and secrets are not returned

retry_and_cancellation.create: required Idempotency-Key with request hash; exact replay is stable, divergent replay is 409
retry_and_cancellation.update: expected_version optimistic concurrency plus exact no-op retry
retry_and_cancellation.database_retry: transaction retries up to three attempts
retry_and_cancellation.cancellation: not applicable to SaveAsync adaptation: synchronous local database persistence and no dispatch/queue/external side effect

proof: canonical operation marker and web/auth/tenant.context route contract
guest, permission and foreign-tenant fail closed
server-derived tenant owner and site_name with authoritative persisted reread
same-result foreign/missing site and foreign-owner/missing job IDOR rejection
strict type/range and unknown identity/secret field rejection
entitlement denial with no persisted schedule
idempotent POST replay and divergent-key conflict
idempotent PUT lost-response replay and stale conflicting version rejection
single audit per real mutation and zero generic scheduled_tasks/automation_rules side effects

terminality.reason: Automation Center Save now has a real session/CSRF-backed tenant-qualified operations.manage mutation path with source-supported schedule types, tenant/site and per-user job isolation, server-derived ownership/site metadata, fail-closed direct-ID behavior, plan and SEO entitlement checks, strict validation, idempotent retries, optimistic concurrency, atomic redacted audit, authoritative post-commit verification, secret/provider isolation and no fake or queued success.
